req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return all players sorted by their insertion order (id) when a GET request is made to the /players/ endpoint. The test suite will include a positive test to verify correct functionality, a negative test to ensure proper error handling, and a boundary test to check edge cases.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_sorted_by_id_positive
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
expected: The players are returned in the order of their ids as per the pre-loaded data.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert len(players) == 26
assert players[0]['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
assert players[1]['id'] == '3a34bd83-441a-4abe-9f6f-210579e1be4b'

tests.name: test_get_all_players_invalid_method
preconditions: The database is pre-loaded with 26 players.
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_get_all_players_empty_database
expected: The response body is an empty list.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 200
players = response.json()
assert players == []
